milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The spruce trapdoors are at spawn-relative (0, 0, 4) and (1, 0, 4) at the building entrance on a contrasting stone brick floor. max_distance reduced to 3 blocks (from original 5) per ValidatorAgent recommendation — since spawn is 4 blocks away from the target, the player must actively walk at least 1-2 blocks forward before this triggers. facing_tolerance of 60° ensures the player is looking toward the trapdoors.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The spruce fence gates are at spawn-relative (0, 1, 13) and (1, 1, 13) behind the building at the back exit. The player must navigate through the entire 8-block-long building corridor and approach within 5 blocks while facing the gates. The 13-block distance from spawn ensures this cannot be triggered early — the player must be at minimum z=8 (well inside the building) to satisfy the distance check.
